correctness.rationale: The sharp support geometry yields a two-step Markov kernel with an order-ell^2 Poincare gap. Transferring this through the density-to-support comparison gives an order-one lower curvature bound, while section-volume control gives the order-ell^{-2} upper bound. Constant and transport-canceling Lipschitz perturbations give matching upper and lower spectral-edge witnesses.

originality.rationale: The inspected linear-convergence and PL papers do not quantify this small-epsilon spectrum, and the new geometry paper supplies the ingredients without stating the resulting condition-number theorem. Searches found no public equivalent statement. Originality is only to the best of our knowledge; an unavailable companion working paper may overlap.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the sharp epsilon^{-2/(d+2)} stiffness exponent of the dual optimizer linearization and hence the exact power law for optimally tuned scalar-step local convergence, sharpening prior qualitative spectral contraction in the smooth quadratic-cost regime.
